note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate --json` (the Rust validator) reports for the same materialized upstream/consumer pair. Each case feeds the unresolved consumer, the resolved upstream (pruned to the fields the rule reads) and the kept trait names the call sites input computes for the reference orbital. Cases mirror orbital_ref_extend.rs and the extend tests of inline/orbital.rs and orbital_import_overrides.rs (collision with an upstream field, collision with a `fields {}` rename target, unread, read through a kept trait, a reference-body sibling or a config knob value), each with its paired control.

findings.message: `extend {}` field 'id' collides with an existing field on 'Up.orbitals.NoteOrbital': already declared on the upstream primary entity (after `fields {}` renames)
findings.suggestion: Rename 'id' in `extend {}` to a name not already on the upstream primary entity and not a `fields {}` rename target.

findings.message: `extend {}` field 'overtimeHours' on 'Up.orbitals.NoteOrbital' is never read, set, rendered, or forwarded by a config knob value — a live wire terminating in nothing.
findings.suggestion: Wire 'overtimeHours' into a trait (guard/effect/render) or an orbital-level config knob (e.g. a `browseColumns`/`formFields` list entry), or remove it from `extend {}`.
